description: Landscape sketch done in red pencil. The drawing is located on the bottom half of the paper. Three large boulder like formations dominate the foreground. In the background, on the right side of the paper, there is a tree. Behind the tree there is the line of the horizon.
title: Untitled (Colorado Landscape)
